page.overview:
Who is Fake Chainsaw Man?

The チェンソーマン|Nise Chensōman}} is an enigmatic figure who serves as a major antagonist in the Academy Saga. He is the unnamed older brother of the student Denji chose to not save during his battle against the Cockroach Devil. He also serves the Chainsaw Man Church as a proxy for the real Chainsaw Man, posing as their religious figure.

Following a failed confrontation with the Death Devil, the Fake Chainsaw Man is brainwashed into serving her and is commanded to plunge humanity into an abyss of terror alongside the Famine Devil.

The Fake Chainsaw Man is a young clear haired male of above average height. He wears an all-black uniform and dark pants which appears to be the common outfit of male Fourth East High School students.

In the past, the Fake Chainsaw Man was once a heroic individual who strived to do the right thing as he admired Chainsaw Man's heroism and saved the Fire Devil with his younger brother. However, after witnessing Denji allowing his younger brother to die at the hands of a Devil to save a cat, the person became vengeful towards him for not saving his brother. However, when he encountered the real Chainsaw Man during the Falling Devil's attack, he expressed a strong desire to help him out in any way possible, indicating he is capable of putting aside desires for the good of others. The Fake Chainsaw Man firmly opposes anything related to the Prophecy of Nostradamus, striving to prevent it from becoming a reality.
